candidates.observed_anchor: 2015 wet versus basal-perforation/drainage package tests water-associated defence, not a structurally alternative bract. 2016 exsertion selection is observational.

positive_sch_conflict_on_fitness_scale.source_basis: Independent SCH P0/P/G conflict budget L with matched context is unexecuted; 2016 selection gradient not a qualified L.

matched_shared_structural_worldline.source_basis: Retained cupulate bract exists in both wet and drained arms; not a structural S architecture.

matched_alternative_structural_worldline.source_basis: Perforation/water-state toggles do not construct a new differentiated bract architecture.

same_biological_context.source_basis: Historical 2015 and 2016 measurements are not the proposed one-population one-season S/D architecture experiment.

common_net_whole_system_fitness_scale.source_basis: Historical seed endpoints are not matched net architecture fitness for S/D on one outcome scale.

preoutcome_accessibility_and_comparator_.source_basis: No prospectively executed structural alternatives or accessibility scope; proposed Experiment B only.

joint_uncertainty_on_worldline_differenc.source_basis: No joint S-versus-net-D structural optimum interval.

structural_intervention_or_architecture_.source_basis: No stable alternative bract structural phenotype with validated cost or removal of architecture.

source_lineage_and_independent_replicati.source_basis: Archived BITA exporter #181 closed unmerged; original SCH/BITA source links absent; no real matched plant-level structural units.

candidates.observed_anchor: Flight-cage evidence: bees preferentially manipulate feeding anthers and pollinating anthers export more pollen. Disabling anthers left floral morphology unchanged.

positive_sch_conflict_on_fitness_scale.source_basis: Pollen-fate division supports functional conflict, but no same-fitness quantified SCH conflict L.

matched_shared_structural_worldline.source_basis: Experiment uses existing dimorphic flowers; no isomorphic-stamen S structural world fitted.

matched_alternative_structural_worldline.source_basis: Functional inactivation of existing anther type, not a distinct structural D compared with S.

same_biological_context.source_basis: Antenna? Not applicable: the trial shares S. rostratum context but lacks a second architecture within that context.

common_net_whole_system_fitness_scale.source_basis: Bee behavior and stigma pollen export are not matched total plant fitness for S and D.

preoutcome_accessibility_and_comparator_.source_basis: The study did not prospectively register a net S-versus-D structural architecture comparison.

joint_uncertainty_on_worldline_differenc.source_basis: No joint confidence interval for optimized net S-D structural fitness difference.

structural_intervention_or_architecture_.source_basis: Existing short feeding and long pollinating anthers are identified as distinct structural modules; this alone does not identify a shared comparator.

source_lineage_and_independent_replicati.source_basis: The study experimentally manipulates functional access within D, not source-linked shared-architecture and differentiated-architecture biological units.

candidates.observed_anchor: Within greenhouse population, authors assigned blossom-level gland/male-flower/resin manipulations and measured hand-pollinated female seed count/mass; no detectable seed cost is not an equivalence proof.

positive_sch_conflict_on_fitness_scale.source_basis: Study quantifies gland/resin production but not independent SCH pollinator-antagonist L on a single net fitness axis.

matched_shared_structural_worldline.source_basis: No intact matched integrated S architecture reference optimized over a shared functional coordinate.

matched_alternative_structural_worldline.source_basis: Excision of staminate flowers and/or gland is not a stable prospective alternative reproductive architecture of the same functions.

same_biological_context.source_basis: Randomized blossom treatments share the greenhouse plant population and study period.

common_net_whole_system_fitness_scale.source_basis: Hand pollination and female seed number/mass omit male fitness; gland/male-flower excision precludes treating seed result as total net fitness.

preoutcome_accessibility_and_comparator_.source_basis: Original treatments not prospectively registered as a S-versus-D net-architecture envelope.

joint_uncertainty_on_worldline_differenc.source_basis: No optimized matched S-vs-D whole-organism fitness difference and joint interval.

structural_intervention_or_architecture_.source_basis: Removing gland/male flowers tests production costs and tissue interference, not a verified developmental architecture variant.

source_lineage_and_independent_replicati.source_basis: Blossoms and plants recorded, but no source-linked independently randomized structural S/D architecture fitness units exist.

candidates.system: Escherichia coli coGFP (one versus two active gene copies)
candidates.observed_anchor: Matched single-active versus double-active copy plasmid constructs, with same backbone/size expression-control strategy. Selection was FACS fluorescence, not competitive organismal fitness; two-copy populations showed no copy-wise colour specialization.

positive_sch_conflict_on_fitness_scale.source_basis: Blue-green fluorescence tradeoff is not a SCH fitness-scale L, independent of architecture state.

matched_shared_structural_worldline.source_basis: One active-copy construct exists, but no common net fitness optimization over a shared coordinate is supplied.

matched_alternative_structural_worldline.source_basis: Two active-copy construct exists, but no matched optimized reproductive/growth net architecture worldline is supplied.

same_biological_context.source_basis: Constructs are deliberately compared in E. coli under experimentally defined fluorescence regimes.

common_net_whole_system_fitness_scale.source_basis: FACS fluorescence is selection proxy, not demonstrated common Malthusian/reproductive fitness; plasmid burden/growth costs are not measured as a net worldline.

preoutcome_accessibility_and_comparator_.source_basis: Fluorescence selection regimes were planned, but not a prospectively declared BALANCE ecological accessibility and architecture-fitness comparator.

joint_uncertainty_on_worldline_differenc.source_basis: No joint fitness-scale optimized single/double architecture comparison.

structural_intervention_or_architecture_.source_basis: One-active and two-active gene-copy constructs are experimentally defined; no claim of specialization follows from copy number.

source_lineage_and_independent_replicati.source_basis: Copy-resolved phenotype and evolution replicates exist, but not source-linked same-scale net growth-fitness optimum data for the BALANCE estimand.

candidates.system: Salmonella enterica HisA/TrpA rescue of trpF deletion (2026)
candidates.observed_anchor: Genetic reconstructions establish bifunctional growth rescue and ancestral-function tradeoffs; only one target-gene duplication was found, without demonstrated functional divergence.

positive_sch_conflict_on_fitness_scale.source_basis: Growth tradeoffs were measured but not the registered independent SCH L optima/budget on one fitness surface.

matched_shared_structural_worldline.source_basis: Reconstructed generalist mutants are tested but not optimized as a shared-architecture worldline against a costed D.

matched_alternative_structural_worldline.source_basis: One duplication without divergence does not identify a matched differentiated/specialized net architecture.

same_biological_context.source_basis: Mutant reconstruction and growth data are in matched laboratory medium, but the required shared-versus-duplicated specialist matched comparison is absent.

common_net_whole_system_fitness_scale.source_basis: Growth AUC is a biological endpoint in this source, but it is not an architecture-paired net S/D worldline response.

preoutcome_accessibility_and_comparator_.source_basis: Not designed with a prospective registered S vs a specialized two-copy D accessible set.

joint_uncertainty_on_worldline_differenc.source_basis: No joint interval for a direct shared versus differentiated net fitness optimum difference.

structural_intervention_or_architecture_.source_basis: No demonstrated differentiated two-copy structural/functional alternative to matched reconstructed bifunctional generalist.

source_lineage_and_independent_replicati.source_basis: Source verifies strain backgrounds and growth assays, but no identified paired S/D architecture comparison of the target.
